beats.say: What happens in your account when you copy an investor on eToro? Let me show you the inside.
You choose an investor, and your account copies each of their trades, automatically and proportionally.
beats.show: You choose an investor and your account copies each trade, automatically and proportionally.

beats.say: When they buy, you buy. When they sell, you sell.
beats.show: When they buy, you buy. When they sell, you sell.

beats.say: This is my public portfolio: twelve point five percent in Meta, nine point six in Microsoft, other positions, and about fifty-eight percent in cash.
beats.show: My public portfolio: 12.5% in Meta, 9.6% in Microsoft, other positions and about 58% in cash.

beats.say: If you copy me with one thousand dollars, your money is split in exactly the same way: one hundred twenty-five in Meta, ninety-six in Microsoft, and so on for every position.
beats.show: If you copy me with $1,000, your money is split the same way: $125 in Meta, $96 in Microsoft, and so on.

beats.say: If I use five percent of my portfolio to buy a new stock, for example Nvidia, your copy uses five percent of your money, fifty dollars, to buy the same one.
beats.show: If I use 5% of my portfolio to buy, say, Nvidia, your copy uses 5% of your money ($50) to buy the same.

beats.say: And if I close my Tesla position, your copy closes it too, and that money goes back to your cash.
beats.show: If I close my Tesla position, your copy closes it too and that money goes back to your cash.

beats.say: Everything rebalances by itself, behind the scenes, without you doing anything.
beats.show: Everything rebalances by itself, behind the scenes, without you doing anything.

beats.say: The value also moves one for one. If a position goes up ten percent, it goes up ten percent for both of us. Same percentage, different size.
beats.show: If a position goes up 10%, it goes up 10% for both of us. Same percentage, different size.

beats.say: One caveat: your result can differ a little. You enter at different prices, positions below one dollar are not opened, and every trade has costs.
beats.show: Your result can differ a little: entry prices, the $1 minimum per position, and costs.

beats.say: You stay in control: you can add or withdraw funds, pause the copy, or stop copying whenever you want.
beats.show: You can add or withdraw funds, pause the copy or stop copying whenever you want.

beats.say: And if you prefer to practise first, eToro gives you a virtual account with one hundred thousand dollars.
beats.show: If you prefer to practise first, eToro gives you a virtual account with $100,000.

beats.say: Save this video if you are learning how copy trading works. Next, I show you how a copy grows when you add money every month.
